thread:
Leah (PM): Proposal: regional canary + A/B quality checks for the new routing optimizer feature. Objective: enable rapid, observable ramp with per-region gating and a simple Sales opt-out. Plan below.

Miguel (Eng): high-level: implement an experiment id + region + tenant triple to route traffic. We'll split traffic into A (baseline) and B (optimizer) within each region and ensure deterministic sampling: `experiment_id:hash(tenant_id||region)%10000 < split_threshold`.

Aria (SRE): Good. Need explicit safety gates. My suggestion: hard gates = (1) region p95 latency regression >250ms vs region baseline sustained 10m, (2) error spike: 5xx rate >0.2% absolute for 5m, (3) token rate throttling: GPU queue >85% for Dedicated for 10m. Soft gates = small quality regressions flagged by evals (see below).

Priya (Sales): Also add a per-customer hold flag. Sales should be able to tag a tenant `hold_until` with a date. That tenant must be excluded from the B cohort even if their hash would include them. We need a console toggle and a short opt-in blurb for legal.

Leah (PM): Proposed rollout cadence per region: 1% (10m smoke), 5% (1h), 20% (6h), 50% (24h), 100% if all gates clear for 48h. A/B comparison windows: compare B vs A over same windows for latency, error rate, and two quality metrics: (Q1) helpfulness (automated eval hit-rate), (Q2) hallucination proxy (factual-check failures).

Miguel (Eng): Implementation details: store explicit overrides so Sales can map tenant->forced-cohort. Also add a `force_degrade` debug route for Ops. Routing fallback hierarchy: 1) tenant-level disable, 2) fall back to baseline route in-region, 3) route to Hosted region if Dedicated capacity is low. Tag requests with `x-experiment-id` and `x-cohort` headers.

Aria (SRE): Observability: emit per-region and per-cohort metrics: request_count, p50/p95 latency, 5xx_count, gpu_queue_depth, eval_helpfulness_score, eval_hallucination_rate. Create two alert levels: page (hard gate) and notify (soft gate). Soft gates should create a ticket in #product-qa.

Priya (Sales): Customers to exclude from early waves: enterprise accounts with active SLAs and the three pilot customers Leah listed. I'll prepare the list and legal opt-in copy. Need a short summary card for customers we can use in onboarding.

qa-bot: Synthetic run results (staging): optimizer B vs baseline A on core prompts: helpfulness +0.6%, hallucination -0.2% (lower is better), p95 latency +40ms. No errors. Simulation of Dedicated pressure showed queue spiking to 78% under 2x load.

Leah (PM): Nice. QA pass means we can schedule a small live canary in one non-critical region. Proposed region: eu-west-2. Target start: Wed 09:30 PT.

Miguel (Eng): Flag schema example (admin API):
```
flag = "routing_optimizer_exp_v1"
params = {
  "experiment_id": "routing_opt_v1",
  "regions": ["eu-west-2","us-west-2"],
  "split_thresholds": {"1%":100, "5%":500, "20%":2000},
  "hash_mod": 10000
}
```
Manual override: `POST /flags/override {"tenant_id":"t-999","experiment_id":"routing_opt_v1","cohort":"A|B|hold"}`

Aria (SRE): Runbook excerpt:
- On hard gate: flip region cohort B -> A (set split_threshold to 0 for that region), notify #oncall, start incident channel.
- On dedicated queue high: enable region->Hosted fallback and throttle B concurrency.
- On soft gate (eval regression): pause further ramp, create ticket, escalate to Eng + PM.

Priya (Sales): One commercial note: any customer manually opted-in to B should be offered the ability to opt-out within 24h of reporting any perf/quality issue. Add to SLA exception language.

Leah (PM): Launch checklist (must be green): staging synthetic run, Dedicated pressure test, override APIs + console working, runbook in #eng-oncall, sales opt-in copy + customer list, dashboards for A/B metrics, legal sign-off.

Miguel (Eng): Also: ensure hash stability across deployments and support remapping of old experiment ids to new ones (migration path). We'll add an idempotent assignment endpoint.

deploy-bot: Live canary started in eu-west-2 for experiment routing_opt_v1 cohort B at 1799999975 :rocket:

Aria (SRE): I'll watch p95 and 5xx closely for first 30m. If anything crosses hard gates, I'll flip cohort immediately.

Leah (PM): Action items: Miguel -> API + overrides + headers (owner: Miguel). Aria -> dashboards + alerts + runbook (owner: Aria). Priya -> customer holdlist + copy (owner: Priya). Leah -> schedule canary + coordinate go/no-go (owner: Leah).

Leah (PM): Let's reconvene after the 1h check-in if the canary stays clean. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
